custom_components/phoenix_mcp/access_key: Storage normalization with no operator-visible behavior.
custom_components/phoenix_mcp/dashboard_: Internal record of the resources Phoenix created; the limit it enforces is described with the capability.
custom_components/phoenix_mcp/durable_st: Storage write barriers; failures surface through the features that write.
custom_components/phoenix_mcp/locales.py: Maps Home Assistant language tags to catalogs; the language setting is documented where it is chosen.
Log handling with no operator setting; tracebacks read as before, minus secrets.
custom_components/phoenix_mcp/schema_com: Chooses a validation engine; no behavior of its own.
Input guard in front of the date parser with no operator-visible behavior.
custom_components/phoenix_mcp/tool_input: Input admission shared by every tool; limits are documented per tool group.
custom_components/phoenix_mcp/ws_dispatc: In-process dispatch helper used by tools.
frontend_src/api.ts: Admin API client; the API itself is documented on the Admin API pages.
frontend_src/guide/targets.ts: Guide section lookup for list rows; checked by the Guide contract.
frontend_src/i18n/format.ts: Number and date formatting from the Home Assistant profile.
frontend_src/ui/motion.ts: Reduced-motion helper with no behaviour of its own to describe.
frontend_src/utils/ime.ts: Input-method guard for key handlers; nothing an operator configures.
frontend_src/utils/page_suspend.ts: Keeps the page awake during a chat turn; the behaviour is described with Agent Chat.
